enabled.description: Enable the network indicator service. If disabled, no network status will be shown in the system tray.

network_manager_service.description: D-Bus service name for the network manager. Typically 'org.freedesktop.NetworkManager'.

items.description: Network interface name to monitor (e.g., 'wlan0', 'eth0'). Only listed interfaces will be tracked.

monitor_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to monitor for connection status. Interfaces not in this list will be ignored.

show_ethernet.description: Display Ethernet (wired) connection status in the network indicator menu.

show_wifi.description: Display Wi-Fi (wireless) connection status in the network indicator menu.

show_bluetooth.description: Display Bluetooth network status (e.g., tethering) in the indicator. May require Bluetooth D-Bus support.

show_mobile.description: Display cellular/mobile data connection status (e.g., 3G/4G/5G) in the indicator.

status_refresh_interval.description: Interval (in milliseconds) between status updates. Lower values give more responsive UI but increase D-Bus traffic.

max_connection_entries.description: Maximum number of saved Wi-Fi connections to display in the indicator menu. Reducing this may improve performance.

auto_join_ssid.description: Optional default Wi-Fi SSID to automatically connect to when in range. Leave empty to disable auto-join.

show_signal_strength.description: Show signal strength indicator (bars or percentage) next to Wi-Fi/mobile connections.

debug_logging.description: Enable verbose logging to the systemd journal. Use for troubleshooting; may affect performance and privacy.
